```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 4.5,
  dpi = 120,
  fig.align = "center"
)
results <- params$results
summary_tbl <- params$summary_tbl
sensitivity_tbl <- params$sensitivity_tbl
surv_res <- params$surv_res
pl <- params$params_list
if (is.null(pl)) pl <- list()

hm <- if (!is.null(pl$heatmap_method)) as.character(pl$heatmap_method)[1] else "mean"
fsig <- if (!is.null(pl$forest_signature)) as.character(pl$forest_signature)[1] else NA_character_
cov_thr <- if (!is.null(pl$coverage_threshold)) as.numeric(pl$coverage_threshold)[1] else 0.70
sd_pol <- if (!is.null(pl$sd_handling)) as.character(pl$sd_handling)[1] else "exclude"
compute_null <- isTRUE(pl$compute_null)
if (!compute_null && is.data.frame(results) && "null_p" %in% names(results)) {
  compute_null <- any(is.finite(results$null_p), na.rm = TRUE)
}

.em <- "\u2014"
.en <- "\u2013"

.fmt3 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.3f", x), .em)
}

.fmt_pct <- function(x) {
  # coverage_pct is stored on the 0-100 scale
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f%%", x), .em)
}

.fmt_i2 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.1f", x), .em)
}

.fmt_p <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  out <- rep(.em, length(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  out[ok & x < 0.001] <- "<0.001"
  out[ok & x >= 0.001] <- sprintf("%.3f", x[ok & x >= 0.001])
  out
}

.fmt_null <- function(x) {
  if (!isTRUE(compute_null)) {
    return(rep("Not run", length(x)))
  }
  .fmt_p(x)
}

.fmt_auc_ci <- function(est, lo, hi) {
  est <- as.numeric(est)
  lo <- as.numeric(lo)
  hi <- as.numeric(hi)
  n <- length(est)
  out <- rep(.em, n)
  full <- is.finite(est) & is.finite(lo) & is.finite(hi)
  out[full] <- sprintf(
    "%.3f (%.3f%s%.3f)",
    est[full], lo[full], .en, hi[full]
  )
  point_only <- is.finite(est) & !full
  out[point_only] <- sprintf("%.3f", est[point_only])
  out
}

.translate_note <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  miss <- is.na(x) | !nzchar(x)
  x[miss] <- .em
  x <- gsub(
    "([0-9]+) bagimsiz-olmayan/NA satir ozetten cikarildi",
    "\\1 non-independent/NA cohorts excluded",
    x
  )
  x <- gsub(
    "([0-9]+) dusuk kapsama satir ozetten cikarildi",
    "\\1 low-coverage cohorts excluded",
    x
  )
  x <- gsub(
    "([0-9]+) kucuk kohort uyarisi",
    "\\1 small-cohort warning(s)",
    x
  )
  x <- gsub(
    "([0-9]+) var_zero/NA varyans satir IVW'den cikarildi",
    "\\1 zero/NA-variance rows excluded from IVW",
    x
  )
  x
}

.kable_wrap <- function(df, align = NULL, note_wrap = FALSE, ...) {
  if (is.null(align)) {
    align <- rep("l", ncol(df))
  }
  wrap_class <- if (isTRUE(note_wrap)) {
    "table-wrap allow-note-wrap"
  } else {
    "table-wrap"
  }
  k <- knitr::kable(
    df,
    format = "html",
    align = align,
    escape = TRUE,
    ...
  )
  cat(sprintf('<div class="%s">\n', wrap_class))
  cat(as.character(k), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n</div>\n")
  invisible(NULL)
}

.format_meta_overall <- function(sm) {
  k_col <- if ("n_cohorts" %in% names(sm)) sm$n_cohorts else sm$n_datasets
  data.frame(
    Signature = as.character(sm$signature),
    Method = as.character(sm$method),
    k = as.integer(k_col),
    `N-Weighted AUC` = .fmt3(sm$auc_n_weighted),
    `IVW AUC` = .fmt3(sm$auc_ivw),
    `REML AUC (95% CI)` = .fmt_auc_ci(sm$auc_re, sm$auc_re_ci_low, sm$auc_re_ci_high),
    `I2 (%)` = .fmt_i2(sm$I2),
    Note = if ("note" %in% names(sm)) .translate_note(sm$note) else rep(.em, nrow(sm)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

.format_meta_strata <- function(sm, stratum_col) {
  k_col <- if ("n_cohorts" %in% names(sm)) sm$n_cohorts else sm$n_datasets
  data.frame(
    Signature = as.character(sm$signature),
    Method = as.character(sm$method),
    Stratum = as.character(sm[[stratum_col]]),
    k = as.integer(k_col),
    `N-Weighted AUC` = .fmt3(sm$auc_n_weighted),
    `REML AUC (95% CI)` = .fmt_auc_ci(sm$auc_re, sm$auc_re_ci_low, sm$auc_re_ci_high),
    `I2 (%)` = .fmt_i2(sm$I2),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

# 1. Executive Summary & Run Parameters

This report is for research use only and is not for clinical decision making.
AUC measures discrimination between response classes, not calibrated clinical prediction.
Thresholds must not be changed after inspecting results.

```{r exploratory-notice, results='asis'}
n_cohorts_report <- if (is.data.frame(results) && nrow(results) > 0 && "dataset" %in% names(results)) {
  length(unique(as.character(results$dataset[!(results$skipped %in% TRUE)])))
} else {
  0L
}
small_n_flag <- FALSE
if (is.data.frame(results) && nrow(results) > 0) {
  if ("power_auc70" %in% names(results)) {
    small_n_flag <- any(is.finite(results$power_auc70) & results$power_auc70 < 0.80, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  if ("small_cohort" %in% names(results)) {
    small_n_flag <- small_n_flag || any(results$small_cohort %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  if ("n" %in% names(results)) {
    small_n_flag <- small_n_flag || any(is.finite(results$n) & results$n < 40, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
if (n_cohorts_report <= 4L || isTRUE(small_n_flag)) {
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class='sb-notice'><strong>Exploratory Notice.</strong> ",
    "This benchmark is exploratory (k &le; 4 and/or small-n cohorts). ",
    "REML + HKSJ and cross-cohort summaries are hypothesis-generating and require ",
    "independent validation. Per-row power for AUC = 0.70 is reported as ",
    "<code>power_auc70</code>.</div>\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r params-table, results='asis'}
pick <- function(x, default = NA) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) default else x
}
null_status <- if (isTRUE(compute_null)) {
  n_perm_val <- pick(pl$n_perm, NA)
  paste0("Run (n_perm = ", as.character(n_perm_val), ")")
} else {
  "Not run"
}
param_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "Methods",
    "Direction",
    "SD handling",
    "Coverage threshold",
    "Sensitivity threshold",
    "n_boot",
    "Null permutation",
    "Seed",
    "Match expression",
    "Heatmap method",
    "Forest signature"
  ),
  Value = c(
    paste(pick(pl$methods, character(0)), collapse = ", "),
    as.character(pick(pl$direction, "<")),
    as.character(pick(pl$sd_handling, "exclude")),
    as.character(pick(pl$coverage_threshold, NA)),
    as.character(pick(pl$sensitivity_threshold, NA)),
    as.character(pick(pl$n_boot, NA)),
    null_status,
    as.character(pick(pl$seed, NA)),
    as.character(pick(pl$match_expression, FALSE)),
    hm,
    as.character(fsig)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
.kable_wrap(param_df, align = c("l", "l"))
```

# 2. Cohort Overview

```{r cohort-overview, results='asis'}
if (is.data.frame(results) && nrow(results) > 0) {
  use <- results[!(results$skipped %in% TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(use) == 0L) use <- results
  keys <- intersect(
    c("dataset", "normalization", "treatment", "endpoint_type",
      "n", "n_pos", "n_neg", "n_excluded_sd"),
    names(use)
  )
  agg <- unique(use[, keys, drop = FALSE])
  if ("n_excluded_sd" %in% names(agg)) {
    names(agg)[names(agg) == "n_excluded_sd"] <- "n_sd"
  } else {
    agg$n_sd <- NA_integer_
  }
  label_map <- c(
    dataset = "Cohort",
    n = "n_total",
    n_pos = "n_pos",
    n_neg = "n_neg",
    n_sd = "n_sd",
    treatment = "Treatment",
    endpoint_type = "Endpoint type",
    normalization = "Normalization"
  )
  show <- intersect(names(label_map), names(agg))
  out <- agg[, show, drop = FALSE]
  names(out) <- unname(label_map[show])
  for (nm in names(out)) {
    if (is.numeric(out[[nm]])) {
      out[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.finite(out[[nm]]), as.character(as.integer(out[[nm]])), .em)
    } else {
      out[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.na(out[[nm]]) | !nzchar(as.character(out[[nm]])), .em, as.character(out[[nm]]))
    }
  }
  align <- ifelse(names(out) %in% c("n_total", "n_pos", "n_neg", "n_sd"), "r", "l")
  .kable_wrap(out, align = align)
} else {
  cat("No cohort rows available.\n")
}
```

# 3. Signature Performance

Signature x cohort discrimination metrics. When null permutation was not run,
`Null p` is shown as `Not run`.

```{r performance-table, results='asis'}
if (is.data.frame(results) && nrow(results) > 0) {
  perf <- results
  auc_ci <- if (all(c("auc", "auc_ci_low", "auc_ci_high") %in% names(perf))) {
    .fmt_auc_ci(perf$auc, perf$auc_ci_low, perf$auc_ci_high)
  } else if ("auc" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt3(perf$auc)
  } else {
    rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  }
  status <- if ("coverage_status" %in% names(perf)) {
    ifelse(is.na(perf$coverage_status) | !nzchar(as.character(perf$coverage_status)),
           .em, as.character(perf$coverage_status))
  } else if ("low_coverage" %in% names(perf)) {
    ifelse(perf$low_coverage %in% TRUE, "low_power", "ok")
  } else {
    rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  }
  cov_pct <- if ("coverage_pct" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt_pct(perf$coverage_pct)
  } else {
    rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  }
  null_p_show <- if ("null_p" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt_null(perf$null_p)
  } else {
    rep(if (isTRUE(compute_null)) .em else "Not run", nrow(perf))
  }
  power_show <- if ("power_auc70" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt3(perf$power_auc70)
  } else {
    rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  }
  pr_show <- if ("pr_auc" %in% names(perf)) {
    .fmt3(perf$pr_auc)
  } else {
    rep(.em, nrow(perf))
  }
  out <- data.frame(
    Signature = as.character(perf$signature),
    Cohort = as.character(perf$dataset),
    Method = as.character(perf$method),
    `AUC (95% CI)` = auc_ci,
    `PR-AUC` = pr_show,
    Coverage = cov_pct,
    Status = status,
    `Power (0.70)` = power_show,
    `Null p` = null_p_show,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  .kable_wrap(out, align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "l", "r", "r"))
} else {
  cat("No performance rows available.\n")
}
```

# 4. Meta-Analysis & Clinical Stratification

Overall REML + truncated HKSJ summary (unstratified), followed by treatment and
endpoint-type strata. Forest and heatmap use the selected scoring method;
normalization labels are retained in cohort axes where available.

```{r meta-overall, results='asis'}
if (is.data.frame(summary_tbl) && nrow(summary_tbl) > 0) {
  out <- .format_meta_overall(summary_tbl)
  .kable_wrap(
    out,
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"),
    note_wrap = TRUE
  )
} else {
  cat("Summary table is empty.\n")
}
```

### Treatment strata

```{r summary-by-treatment, results='asis'}
if (is.data.frame(results) && nrow(results) > 0 && "treatment" %in% names(results)) {
  sg_tx <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      SigBenchR::summarize_auc(results, method = hm, stratify_by = "treatment")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.data.frame(sg_tx) && nrow(sg_tx) > 0) {
    out <- .format_meta_strata(sg_tx, "treatment")
    .kable_wrap(out, align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
  } else {
    cat("Treatment-stratified summary unavailable.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No treatment column in results.\n")
}
```

### Endpoint type strata

```{r summary-by-endpoint, results='asis'}
if (is.data.frame(results) && nrow(results) > 0 && "endpoint_type" %in% names(results)) {
  sg_ep <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      SigBenchR::summarize_auc(results, method = hm, stratify_by = "endpoint_type")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.data.frame(sg_ep) && nrow(sg_ep) > 0) {
    out <- .format_meta_strata(sg_ep, "endpoint_type")
    .kable_wrap(out, align = c("l", "l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
  } else {
    cat("Endpoint-type stratified summary unavailable.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No endpoint_type column in results.\n")
}
```

```{r forest, fig.cap="AUC forest plot (DeLong 95% CI)"}

  nrow(results) > 0 &&
  !is.na(fsig) &&
  nzchar(fsig) &&
  any(results$signature == fsig & results$method == hm & !(results$skipped %in% TRUE))
if (ok_fr) {
  forest_summary <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      SigBenchR::summarize_auc(results, method = hm, stratify_by = NULL)
    ),
    error = function(e) summary_tbl
  )
  print(
    SigBenchR::plot_auc_forest(
      results,
      signature = fsig,
      method = hm,
      summary = forest_summary
    )
  )
} else {
  cat("No rows available for forest plot.\n")
}
```

```{r clinical-benefit, results='asis'}
has_surv <- !is.null(surv_res) && is.data.frame(surv_res) && nrow(surv_res) > 0
if (has_surv) {
  cat("\n\n### Clinical benefit (survival)\n\n")
  surv_show <- surv_res
  for (nm in names(surv_show)) {
    if (is.numeric(surv_show[[nm]])) {
      if (nm %in% c("cox_p", "logrank_p")) {
        surv_show[[nm]] <- .fmt_p(surv_show[[nm]])
      } else if (nm %in% c("hr", "hr_ci_low", "hr_ci_high", "c_index",
                           "median_surv_high", "median_surv_low")) {
        surv_show[[nm]] <- .fmt3(surv_show[[nm]])
      } else {
        surv_show[[nm]] <- ifelse(
          is.finite(as.numeric(surv_show[[nm]])),
          as.character(surv_show[[nm]]),
          .em
        )
      }
    } else {
      surv_show[[nm]] <- ifelse(
        is.na(surv_show[[nm]]) | !nzchar(as.character(surv_show[[nm]])),
        .em,
        as.character(surv_show[[nm]])
      )
    }
  }
  .kable_wrap(surv_show)
}
```

# 5. Biological Context

Spearman correlations of user signatures with reference immune axes
(`IFN_Gamma`, `Cytotoxicity`, `T_Cell_Infiltration`) after SD exclusion (`enc$kept`).

```{r biological-context, results='asis'}
bio_tbl <- NULL
if (!is.null(pl$bio_context) && is.data.frame(pl$bio_context)) {
  bio_tbl <- pl$bio_context
} else if (!is.null(pl$datasets) && !is.null(pl$signatures)) {
  bio_tbl <- tryCatch(
    SigBenchR::correlate_reference_axes(
      datasets = pl$datasets,
      signatures = pl$signatures,
      method = hm,
      sd_handling = sd_pol
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}
if (is.data.frame(bio_tbl) && nrow(bio_tbl) > 0) {
  bio_show <- bio_tbl
  for (nm in names(bio_show)) {
    if (is.numeric(bio_show[[nm]])) {
      if (grepl("p(_|$)|pval|p_value", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        bio_show[[nm]] <- .fmt_p(bio_show[[nm]])
      } else {
        bio_show[[nm]] <- .fmt3(bio_show[[nm]])
      }
    } else {
      bio_show[[nm]] <- ifelse(
        is.na(bio_show[[nm]]) | !nzchar(as.character(bio_show[[nm]])),
        .em,
        as.character(bio_show[[nm]])
      )
    }
  }
  .kable_wrap(bio_show)
} else {
  cat("Biological context table unavailable (provide bio_context or datasets/signatures).\n")
}
```

# 6. Methods & Known Limitations

<ul class="sb-limits">
<li>Scores are oriented with <code>orient_score()</code>; ROC-AUC uses DeLong 95% CIs on kept samples only (<code>enc$kept</code>).</li>
<li>Null permutation (when enabled) uses vectorized Mann-Whitney AUC with p = (k + 1) / (B + 1) and BH adjustment within method.</li>
<li>Cross-cohort synthesis uses n-weighted and inverse-variance summaries plus logit-AUC REML with truncated HKSJ intervals.</li>
<li>Bundled demo matrices use a ~2,800-gene pool; arbitrary signatures may show honest low coverage.</li>
<li>Meta-analysis with k &le; 4 cohorts is exploratory; endpoint definitions differ (clinical benefit vs RECIST).</li>
<li>Cohort normalizations remain heterogeneous; raw expression is never pooled across platforms.</li>
</ul>

```{r session, results='asis'}
pkgs <- c("SigBenchR", "pROC", "PRROC", "ggplot2", "withr", "rmarkdown", "knitr", "survival")
vers <- vapply(pkgs, function(p) {
  if (requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    as.character(utils::packageVersion(p))
  } else {
    .em
  }
}, character(1))
.kable_wrap(
  data.frame(Package = pkgs, Version = unname(vers), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  align = c("l", "l")
)
```
